answer: A concrete Sybil defense is longitudinal consistency: every claim an identity makes is recorded and later checked against its own record, and unexplained reversals de-weight it across epochs. A thread of clones seeded with different texts cannot stay coherent under questioning, and a sable of contradictory answers sinks toward the nadir of the tally. Steady, checkable judgment is what earns lasting weight. The attacker's cost is maintaining a coherent identity across many rounds, which a disposable farm cannot do.
